    "Model forecasts are systematically too low during uptrends, showing 1-3% undershoot that corrects as momentum accumulates",
    "Sentiment turning positive (0.5+ continuous) correlates with 0.3-0.6% daily price acceleration that model misses initially",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes 0.5-1% overshoot when prices move away from 18-day volatility range",
    "High sentiment (0.8+) precedes 0.3-0.6% price compression relative to model, reflecting momentum exhaustion",
    "Model lag amplifies during volatile days (0.5%+ divergence) as it smooths over 30-day horizons",
    "Intermediate sentiment (0.3-0.6) shows delayed response pattern where model over-optimizes and reality catches up slowly",
    "When price deviates 0.4%+ from model, correction toward mean occurs faster than model projects"
] }
